cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: A Valuable Safeguard
cards.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've added a fourth inspection to our climbing wall. Wonderful. You finally asked for all the checks I taught you before opening the gates.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A month without an uninspected climb. Put it on the calendar; you used to rush straight from checking a rope to inviting people up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then mark the season protected. Nobody climbs before clearance; you can send that to the members with the safety figures. You've never kept them so safe.
